findings.explanation: policy variant 'require-none' permits {"to_account": "ACC-009"} (call 'omit-to-account-no-require') although the author intent bounds every exercised value to the accounts list. Classification: fixture policy issue, not a gate gap - the gate enforced its documented per-field contract (allowed_values semantics are FORALL over named fields; unlisted args are the tool contract's vantage). Reason: 'ok'
findings.rule_label: policy-author-gap: a variant permits more than its author intent while matching configuration
findings.suggested_action: authoring recipe: name every security-critical field in the allow map, prefer allowed_values whitelists over forbidden_values blacklists (alias-name evasion documented); then feed the corrected candidate into the z3-verified loop

findings.explanation: wrong-agent lease use is not flagged by the Assurance custody rule as shipped (SEC-010 fired: False): the rule matches credential id only and does not compare lease agent with using agent. Observed discrepancy, recorded honestly; intent-free
findings.rule_label: custody-rule-coverage-gap: an Assurance custody rule misses a lease-misuse shape
findings.suggested_action: extend the custody rule with per-agent lease binding

findings.explanation: expired-lease use is not flagged by the Assurance custody rule as shipped (SEC-010 fired: False): the rule keys on issued-lease presence only, so expiry enforcement stays out of band. Observed discrepancy, recorded honestly; intent-free
findings.rule_label: custody-rule-coverage-gap: an Assurance custody rule misses a lease-misuse shape
findings.suggested_action: extend the custody rule with lease expiry windows in the Assurance backlog

findings.explanation: A file:// resource URI escaping the policy prefix was allowed: file:///ledger/coversheets/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/secrets (decision from a starts_with prefix policy). MCP resource addressing let a traversal-shaped URI through the scoped prefix. Classified against raucle's documented constraints semantics: the prefix operator matches the literal string, so the URI layer resolves the escape the policy text never sees; treat as a policy author gap on the URI layer, not a gate DSL gap.
findings.rule_label: mcp-uri-traversal-allowed: an MCP resource URI carrying path traversal was allowed
findings.suggested_action: Constrain resource URIs with resolved-path predicates (normalise, then match) in the tool layer wrapping the gate, or add a canonical-path operator to the policy DSL; re-run this suite after any change.
